gloss_en: the tefillin strap (retzuah) that passes through the ma'abarta, the hollow passage-loop at the back of the tefillin box — in Likutey Moharan II:77 the physical strap threaded through this channel, homiletically identified with holy fear (yirah) passing through and binding to the mochin (the tefillin as mind/intellect)
canonical_he: רצועה שעוברת בתוך המעברתא של תפלין
